# cozystack_kubernetes (Ephemeral Resource)

The admin kubeconfig of a Cozystack-managed Kubernetes cluster, fetched at apply time without ever being stored in state. Use it to configure a downstream `kubernetes`/`helm` provider for the cluster.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Kubernetes cluster name.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace.

### Read-Only

- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Admin kubeconfig.
